name: Capsule CRM
description: Capsule CRM manages people, organisations, opportunities, projects, tasks, activities, pipelines, and custom fields.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Capsule CRM Bearer token, then let agents list only bounded projected party custom-field metadata under approval. Relay excludes descriptions, tags, options, values, CRM records, writes, administration, beta MCP, bulk operations, and raw API access.

credentialRequirements.name: CAPSULE_CRM_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Capsule CRM access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store a dedicated least-privilege Bearer token only through Relay's encrypted flow.

capabilities.label: List party custom-field metadata
capabilities.description: List at most 100 field IDs, names, types, display order, capture rules, and importance flags without descriptions, tags, options, values, or CRM records.

approvalRequired.label: List party custom-field metadata
approvalRequired.description: List bounded projected party custom-field definitions from Capsule CRM.

blocked.label: Access CRM records
blocked.description: Parties, people, organisations, opportunities, projects, tasks, activities, history, files, users, teams, and goals are blocked.

blocked.label: Access private schema logic
blocked.description: Descriptions, data tags, list options, link templates, field values, and full definitions are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Capsule CRM
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, imports, exports, tracks, pipelines, milestones, boards, stages, users, teams, and settings changes are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw, MCP, or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary entities, paths, filters, embeds, raw responses, beta MCP, later pages, redirects, retries, and bulk access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded field-metadata read requires approval; CRM records, private schema logic, writes, administration, MCP, bulk, and raw APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded metadata read runs without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/path/entity/query binding, projection, caps, audits, and no-write behavior remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway binds a customer-owned token to Capsule CRM's fixed API origin and projected party custom-field wrapper.
Railway binds a customer-owned token to Capsule CRM's fixed API origin and projected party custom-field wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized Capsule CRM administrator must provision a dedicated least-privilege Bearer token and store it through Relay. No account, OAuth app, token, credential capture, consent, live request, or provider acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator provisions the least-privilege token, stores it through Relay, then verifies health, one approved metadata list, throttling, token rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Capsule documents GET /api/v2/{entity}/fields/definitions with parties, opportunities, or kases, page/perPage bounds, and definition fields including descriptions, tags, capture rules, options, and importance. Relay fixes parties, page one, 100 results, and projects only low-risk identity/type fields.
Capsule documents a private-beta local MCP server with broad read-only CRM tools. Relay blocks MCP and selects the narrower fixed REST metadata operation.
